title: Material is very cheap. But looks 🔥 amazing!!
text: Material is very cheap. But looks 🔥 amazing!!. I love the look soooo much. But it’s not wood. It’s pressboard and big chunks come out and it dents super easy if it slightly bumps against something. The hardware they send with this is very cheap. The screw head is angled so when slipped into the back hanging hooks, they move around and don’t feel secure.  I ended up using metal wall anchors vs the plastic ones they sent. I also used a flat head screw that lays flush against hanging hooks so it won’t wobble. These are very lightweight and I doubt will last very long. I love the look so much tho. I want a solid wood set!
